thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager alert — inference-runtime-eu1 latency spike (P2). 90th p50->p95 jump, several user requests timing out. Auto-bridge created. Incident link: https://incidents.internal/INC-2026-3342 :rotating_light:
Ana R: i'm looking — seeing a surge to 5xx on the model-router, not 502s but timeouts. clients: two mid-market customers hitting heavy batch jobs.
Devon: sorry can we get a quick handoff? I'm on PTO starting in 30m and i'm primary for the shift.
Sanjay: i can take primary if someone confirms secondary. who is on shadow tonight?
Katie M: i'm currently the scheduled shadow but gonna step out for a doc appointment in ~20m. can we find a swap fast?
Eli Chen: i can be secondary until 0200 UTC, after that i need to hand off.
Ana R: short notes: root cause looks like a combination of eviction storms in the KV-cache and a model-worker OOM on host eu1-gpu-07 triggering retries. runbook suggests restarting the worker and warming cache.
Devon: pinging the runbook to whoever takes primary: https://playbooks/redwood/inference-runtime/kv-cache-eviction.md
Sanjay: i'll take primary now. eli you ok to be secondary and handle customer comms?
Eli Chen: yep i'll do customer comms. can someone paste the minimal steps to restart worker?
Ana R: paste runbook snippet — quick steps: ```bash
# restart failing worker on node
ssh gpu-admin@eu1-gpu-07
sudo systemctl restart redwood-model-worker
# check pod logs
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=redwood-model-worker -c worker | tail -n 200
# warm kv cache via replay script
python tools/warm_cache.py --model gpt-medium --host eu1 --prefixes /opt/warm/prefixes.json
```
Devon: also note: if worker keeps OOMing, switch to lighter quantized variant and route traffic: `route-policy set inference-runtime-eu1 --model gpt-medium-8bit --weight 0.5`
Katie M: on customer impact — which tenants affected? Ana?
Ana R: two tenants: AcmePay and FidelisHealth. Error rates ~8% for ACME, ~12% for Fidelis for last 12m. Notifying SRE/CS now.
Sanjay: thanks. Eli can you open a quick CS thread and paste this? add suggested mitigation timeline.
Eli Chen: on it. CS thread created: convo id 5582. pinged acct owners, said we're mitigating and may apply temporary model downgrade to preserve availability.
Devon: btw i'm still happy to do an automated warm-cache if you want me to run it before i head off — takes ~4m.
Ana R: that would help. if you can kick warm_cache with conservative prefixes that'd lower cold-start tail.
Devon: running now — output: ```
WARM: queued 120 prefixes
WARM: 80 warmed, 40 pending
WARM: completed 120 prefixes in 3m12s
``` :thumbsup:
Sanjay: restarted worker on eu1-gpu-07 per runbook. logs look green but i'm watching for OOM repeat.
Ana R: seeing 95th latency drop from 1.8s -> 1.05s. error rate down to 3% for ACME, 4% for FIDELIS. keep an eye on CPU on model-router.
Katie M: quick note for handoff: i need cover 0215-0500 UTC. Eli you'll be secondary until 0200, then who takes after 0200?
Eli Chen: after 0200 i can extend to 0300 if needed but have a hard constraint at 0300.
Sanjay: i'm around until 0400 and can cover after 0300 if last longer.
Ana R: awesome — handoff plan: SANG (Sanjay) primary until 0400, Eli secondary until 0300, Katie resumes shadow at 0215? (Katie: confirm)
Katie M: i can come back online by 0215 and take shadow then. thanks all.
Devon: small follow-up — we should file a postmortem on eviction tuning; hot prefixes causing KV memory pressure. i'll create the ticket when back from PTO.
Ana R: agree. for now monitoring and customer updates every 15m until fully stabilized. if OOM recurs, plan B is traffic split to gpt-medium-8bit and scale up capacity in eu1.
Eli Chen: leaving a clear check list in the incident channel for whoever covers next: 1) check worker OOMs 2) confirm KV-cache warm status 3) monitor 95th latency 4) keep customers updated via CS convo 5582.
Sanjay: acknowledged. tagging this for on-call rotation docs: @oncall-rota please note unexpected gap filled by Sanjay/Eli/Katie/Devon. :hand:
incident-bot: Incident auto-bridge will remain open for 2 hours. Runbook link pinned. :information_source:
Ana R: closing note before i head to other task — we've stabilized for now, but i'll leave a follow-up on runbook to add a step to auto-warm on worker restart. good work team. :tada:
